compare-numbers-skill-01.target: I can tell which of two numbers is greater by comparing the tens first, then the ones.
compare-numbers-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can tell which of two numbers is greater by comparing the tens first, then the ones.
compare-numbers-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Comparing the ones digits first (29 is greater than 41 because 9 > 1). Try this: Build both numbers with blocks; the number with more tens is greater.

compare-numbers-skill-02.target: I can write a comparison using the symbols >, =, and <.
compare-numbers-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can write a comparison using the symbols >, =, and <.
compare-numbers-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Pointing the symbol the wrong way. Try this: The open side of the symbol faces the greater number.

compare-numbers-skill-03.target: I can find numbers that make a comparison true and explain my thinking.
compare-numbers-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can find numbers that make a comparison true and explain my thinking.
compare-numbers-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Thinking a number with a bigger ones digit is always greater. Try this: Check the tens digits first and use a number line to see which number comes later.
